chapter: Life on the road and in the Webb band's book
title: Chick brings young Buddy Rich to sit in
summary: Webb let Buddy Rich play a set at the Savoy and told the band to remember his name.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: And one night, we were at the Savoy Ballroom playing, and Chick brought up Buddy Rich. Buddy Rich was a young guy -- brought him up from the Village. "Yeah, yeah, I got a guy I went to (inaudible) hear."
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
"He got two fast feet, wrist good. You gonna hear a lot from him."
And he let -- he played a set and he let Buddy get up in the band. I think the band scared Buddy to death, you know.
I think the band really scared him to death, because I don't think Buddy played in a band that heavy, you know.
And Chick called a set and we throwed a set on Buddy, man, and he played. He played good, you know.
But I think the first time sitting in a band like that, you know, really got to him, you know.
Chick say, "He's gonna be good. Keep your eyes (inaudible)."
Chick told us, he say, "If I don't be around, keep it in mind, this guy. Remember this name, Buddy Rich. He's gonna be a great drummer one day."
Chick let other drummers sit in with the band?
S. & S. REPORTING COMPANY, INC. WOrth 2-2915 WOrth 2-2943
Very few. Very few could sit in that band.
See, in the Savoy, wasn't no place for nobody to sit in unless you were great like Buddy Rich, or somebody like Gene Krupa Cooper, or somebody.
Big Sid Catlett will come in. Drummers he knew that could --
